english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for opposition or the act of objecting, especially in phrases such as 對某事嘅反對.
This is the all-purpose noun for disagreement or resistance to a proposal, person, or action.
Use this when the disapproval is opposition to a proposal, decision, action, or opinion.

examples.english: I have an objection to holding a party at home.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 faan2 deoi3 hai2 uk1 kei2 hoi1 paai3 deoi3

examples.english: I have opposition to this rent increase proposal.
examples.traditional: 我對呢個加租建議有反對意見。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 gaa1 zou1 gin3 ji5 jau5 faan2 deoi3 ji3 gin3

examples.english: I showed my disapproval by opposing the cancellation of the event.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 faan2 deoi3 ceoi2 siu1 go3 wut6 dung6
